concepts.way: misconception: The else branch of an if-else statement always executes.
concepts.quote: A and then B, the else always runs at the end.
concepts.why: In Java only one branch runs, so (a) prints just A, but the answer says the else always runs.
The answer says nothing about statements in general or their order.
The answer does not discuss the variable x or its value.
Binary conversion is not part of this answer.
